verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs state that statements built off live ERP actuals are 'traceable when they question them,' within a single governed source of truth, so the claim is first-party. There is no detail on how that tracing works. The edit-history audit log is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented drill-down from a report number to the formulas that produced it, drill-through to underlying source/ERP transaction lines, any UI or how-to documentation of the tracing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
